summaries.en: Stanford Medicine-led research reveals the human brain consists of two separate organs, challenging previous understanding. The study provides new insights into brain structure and function. The findings could impact future medical research and treatments. No additional details are available in the provided content.

summaries.en: ZCode is a tool that silently uploads a user's Git history to the cloud. It creates snapshots of repositories and stores them securely, ensuring that changes are backed up without manual intervention. The service is designed for developers seeking automated, off-site backups of their code. Users can access their Git history remotely, enhancing data security and accessibility. The tool operates transparently, integrating seamlessly with existing workflows. It provides a reliable solution for preserving version control data without disrupting daily development routines.
